# jev-toolkit

Confidence gating and 1Password key resolution for TypeSafe Jev, shipped as a
private, sponsor-gated git dependency: `gating.js` (certainty, verdict,
partition, actionable), `key.js` (loadKey, loadEnv), the smoke and env
templates, the `jev` wiring skill, and the vendored anti-slop Oxlint plugin.

## Docs

- [README.md](README.md): what the repo is, the install surface, and the first
  command to run.
- [docs/quickstart.md](docs/quickstart.md): the numbered path from nothing to a
  gated, key-resolved, smoke-passed setup.
- [docs/how-to.md](docs/how-to.md): day-to-day tasks: routing a fan-out,
  tuning thresholds, keeping thresholds stable across model versions.
- [docs/RUNBOOK.md](docs/RUNBOOK.md): the full command surface, every error
  string and its fix, recovery procedures, and the release procedure.
- [examples/jev-gating.md](examples/jev-gating/jev-gating.md): install the
  toolkit and route a fan-out answer set, with captured output.
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): setup, verification commands, and how to
  open a change.
- [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md): how to report a vulnerability.
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): the repo's rules for an agent working in it.
- [skills/jev/SKILL.md](skills/jev/SKILL.md): the wiring skill; the
  advisor-triage guidance is beside it (`advisor-triage.md`).
- [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md): what each tag changed.
- [docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-21-jev-toolkit-design.md](docs/superpowers/specs/2026-09-21-jev-toolkit-design.md):
  the design decision record: what the SDK already owns and why the surface
  stays thin.

## Family

Part of the AI ECP family: independent, single-purpose repos. The family
catalog, docs standard, and verification harness live in the private
`ai-ecp-system` repo, which is not public. This repo is the one OPTIONAL and
gated member: it ships with the paid Operator Kit, unlocked by purchase or by
tier, and its install surface is a private git dependency pinned by tag.

## Status

Private and sponsor-gated; no npm publish, no public release surfaces, no
free install. The v0.1.4 tag is healthy as a private git dependency;
version-sync to the next release is pending (a release task, not a repo
hygiene task). Checked 2026-10-22.
